content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] with a [product_name] and the [product_name] communication module. After some time, the communication module shows a red 'RUN' status. In this situation, the controller switches to STOP mode and needs to be restarted. This repeats periodically after several days. Does anyone have any advice? Best regards.

This might be related to the [product_name] with [article_no] if the firmware version is greater than [version_no]. On the German-speaking section of the forum, there's a post discussing networked controllers with this model. If the controller isn't networked, this issue doesn't seem to appear.
Hi [user_name], Thank you, that's exactly the answer for my case. I hope there will be a solution soon. Best regards.
Hello [user_name], Unfortunately, a quick solution is unlikely. Even if one existed, it would mean needing a new controller, since the firmware on current models can't be updated.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have encountered a situation where a communication module, when used with a specific controller and operating panel, enters an ongoing error condition, causing the controller to stop and require restarts. This issue occurs repeatedly over time and is associated with certain firmware versions, especially in networked setups. Firmware updates are not possible on these devices to fix the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want stable, uninterrupted operation of their controller setup with the communication module, and a fix that does not require changing hardware.
